trace_method.events: JSON.stringify([kind, ...arguments]) plus newline into ordered SHA-256; tuples sorted lexicographically with exact integer multiplicities for direct original/proposed equality and multiset SHA-256. trace_method.instrumentation: Only audit runs replace expect with Object.is-based toBe and numeric > toBeGreaterThan validators, recording all inputs. Original assertion expressions remain intact. Uninstrumented real Vitest green/sabotage runs separately validate both variants. No deadlines changed.
trace_method.diagnostic: An initial full-real-expect Proxy trace exceeded the unchanged 5000ms default in six heavy cases. Replaced only the temporary tracing mechanism, not committed test assertions or gate commands. One separate uninstrumented pre-change diagnostic hit 5019ms on the first gem case; later baseline whole-unit and all 14 retained benchmark executions passed unchanged. Not counted as a clean run.
